name: Face Direction and Quad Geometry
aliases: FaceDir, Index Generation, Quad Position Generation, UV Generation
Voxel Face Mesh Generation > Face Direction and Quad Geometry
definition: Defines the six axis-aligned face directions on a cube and provides helpers for generating quad geometry (positions, indices, UVs) for meshing.
summary: Face Direction and Quad Geometry deterministically generates mesh vertex and index buffers from voxel face orientations using strict axis conventions and winding rules to ensure consistent texture orientation and backface culling.
